evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a test case as reproducing a production failure pattern positions the speaker as one who diagnoses and prescribes against a known authoritative reference point, enacting hierarchical authority over what counts as a valid reproduction.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Bare imperative 'must' clauses issue a command without negotiation or reciprocity, enacting authority-ranking directly toward whoever must comply.
